name: Freezing a card calls freeze_card for the right card

chat_history.message: What cards do I have on my account?
You have your own credit card ending 4821, and a supplementary card for Fatima ending 7734.
Please freeze my card, the one ending 4821, I think I lost it.

eval.description: Should identify the customer's own card ending 4821, not Fatima's supplementary card ending 7734.
